contact_channel.description: How the customer wants to be contacted

escalated_to.description: Person or team now handling the customer's case

note.description: A statement worth keeping that no other predicate fits, in the words it was stated

open_issue.description: A problem the customer reported that is not resolved

plan.description: Plan or tier the customer is on

preferred_language.description: Language the customer wants to be answered in

promised.description: Something the customer was told would be done

resolved_issue.description: A problem the customer reported that has been resolved

sentiment.description: How the customer feels about the service right now

uses_product.description: Product or feature the customer uses
